title: triage.yaml
description: Configuration for the triage environment doctor (spec §4–§5). Root is always a mapping: the reserved 'include' key composes other files, every other key is a profile.

include.title: include
include.description: Files to compose, processed in order. Paths resolve relative to this file's directory. Collisions (same profile + check) are flagged at load time; the later definition wins.

vars.title: vars
vars.description: Reusable values referenced via {{ name }} in check fields. Overridable with --var name=value.

profile.title: profile
profile.description: A named set of checks. Either a list of checks, or an {extends, add} mapping that inherits other profiles.

extends.description: Profiles to inherit from (override semantics; cycle/diamond-safe).

add.description: Checks appended to the inherited set.

severity.description: How a failure is treated, orthogonal to profile (spec §7.1).

platform.description: OS guard: run the check only on matching platforms.

required.description: Sugar for severity: true → error, false → warn.

hint.description: Actionable remediation shown when the check is not passing.

dir.description: Working directory for the check; relative paths resolve from here.

serial.description: Opt this check (or, on a group, its whole subtree) out of concurrency: run it as a barrier under a global serial lock. Use only for a shared scarce resource (exclusive lock, rate-limited auth, keychain). Default is parallel.

check.title: check
check.description: A single declarative check. Exactly one type key (tool/env/path/one_of/command/delegate/group) is required.

tool.description: Command that must be present on PATH. Optional version / version_from.

env.description: Environment variable to assert present (default) or absent (with unset: true).

path.description: File or directory that must exist (globs allowed).

one_of.description: At least one alternative must be present: bare tool names or nested sub-checks.

command.description: Explicitly-interpreted, platform-guarded snippet (never an implicit shell). Requires a label.

delegate.description: Display name for a nested triage.yaml loaded from dir:.

group.description: Structural group container: section name. Children live under items:.

items.description: Child checks (and nested groups) of a structural group.

version.description: npm-style semver range for a tool (e.g. ">=1.26", "^1.2.0", "1.x"). Quote in YAML.

version_from.description: Pin file to read the version constraint from (.go-version, .nvmrc, .terraform-version, …). A bare version becomes ">=x".

unset.description: For env: assert the variable is NOT set. Mutually exclusive with matches.

matches.description: Regex asserted against the env value (env) or command stdout (command).

exit.description: Expected exit code for a command (default 0).

interp.description: Interpreter for a command: sh (default) or pwsh. Never implicit.

with_env.description: Environment variables to set for a command check (layered over the inherited environment; values support {{profile}}).

label.description: Friendly name. Required for command checks; identity key for command/one_of.

config.description: For delegate: path to the child config, default triage.yaml under dir:.
